result.stdout:
Banyan MCP Memory Server

Usage: banyan-mcp [options]

  --db PATH          Path to memory.db         (default: ~/.banyan/memory.db)
  --namespace NS     Default write namespace    (default: default)
  --sqlite-vec PATH  sqlite-vec extension path  (optional)
  --quick            Accepted for compatibility; quick mode is always enabled
  --version, -v      Show the installed server version

The server uses the offline hashing embedder and MCP stdio transport.
